manifest.title: The Immerman–Szelepcsényi Theorem

inputs.abstract: We prove $\mathrm{NL}=\mathrm{coNL}$ by inductive counting on finite configuration graphs. The proof constructs a nondeterministic Turing machine that generates paths and census witnesses sequentially, halts on every branch, and uses logarithmic space. Machine classes come from lax-434930; configuration encodings and stack routines come from lax-307052.

concepts.title: Correctness of vertex classification
concepts.description:
With the correct current count, a vertex has a valid positive or negative
classification exactly according to its membership in the next layer.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax733996.Counting

/-!
---
title: Correctness of vertex classification
type: lemma
---
With the correct current count, a vertex has a valid positive or negative
classification exactly according to its membership in the next layer.
-/

namespace Lax733996.Classification

open Lax307052.Reachability Counting

axiom correct {N : ℕ} (G : Graph N) (a v : Fin N) (k : ℕ) (b : Bool) :
  Classify G a k (layer G a k).card v b ↔
    (b = true ↔ v ∈ layer G a (k + 1))

end Lax733996.Classification

statements.signature:
correct : ∀ {N : Nat} (G : Lax307052.Reachability.Graph N) (a v : Fin N) (k : Nat) (b : Bool),
  Iff (Lax733996.Counting.Classify G a k (Lax733996.Counting.layer G a k).card v b)
    (Iff (Eq b Bool.true) (SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax733996.Counting.layer G a (instHAdd.hAdd k 1)) v))

concepts.title: Counting on the configuration graph
concepts.description:
For every terminal accepting configuration, certify that it cannot be
reached from the initial configuration. The implementation must generate
the witnesses sequentially; this predicate alone makes no space claim.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax307052.ConfigurationGraph
import Lax733996.Counting

/-!
---
title: Counting on the configuration graph
type: definition
---
For every terminal accepting configuration, certify that it cannot be
reached from the initial configuration. The implementation must generate
the witnesses sequentially; this predicate alone makes no space claim.
-/

namespace Lax733996.ConfigurationCounting

open Lax434930.PolynomialTime Lax434930.SpaceMachines
open Lax307052.BoundedConfigurations Lax307052.ConfigurationGraph Counting

def RejectsByCounting (M : Machine) (w : Word) (s : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ a b : Config M w.length s, expand a = M.initial →
    M.Terminal w (expand b) → M.accept b.state = true →
    NonreachCertificate (graph M w s) (numbering M w.length s a) (numbering M w.length s b)

end Lax733996.ConfigurationCounting

concepts.title: Inductive counting certificates
concepts.description:
The $k$th reachable layer contains vertices at distance at most $k$ from the
source. A census lists distinct reachable vertices and their path witnesses.
Given the correct census size, a negative classification checks that no
listed vertex has an edge to the target. A counting step classifies every
vertex and counts the positive answers.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax307052.Reachability
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Powerset

/-!
---
title: Inductive counting certificates
type: definition
---
The $k$th reachable layer contains vertices at distance at most $k$ from the
source. A census lists distinct reachable vertices and their path witnesses.
Given the correct census size, a negative classification checks that no
listed vertex has an edge to the target. A counting step classifies every
vertex and counts the positive answers.
-/

namespace Lax733996.Counting

open Lax307052.Reachability

noncomputable def layer {N : ℕ} (G : Graph N) (a : Fin N) (k : ℕ) : Finset (Fin N) := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun v => Within (fun u v => G u v = true) k a v)

def Census {N : ℕ} (G : Graph N) (a : Fin N) (k c : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin N)) : Prop :=
  S.card = c ∧ ∀ v ∈ S, Within (fun u v => G u v = true) k a v

def Classify {N : ℕ} (G : Graph N) (a : Fin N) (k c : ℕ) (v : Fin N) : Bool → Prop
  | true => Within (fun u v => G u v = true) (k + 1) a v
  | false => ∃ S, Census G a k c S ∧ v ≠ a ∧ ∀ u ∈ S, G u v = false

def CountStep {N : ℕ} (G : Graph N) (a : Fin N) (k c d : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ answers : Fin N → Bool, (∀ v, Classify G a k c v (answers v)) ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => answers v = true)).card = d

def CountTrace {N : ℕ} (G : Graph N) (a : Fin N) (counts : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  counts 0 = 1 ∧ ∀ k < N, CountStep G a k (counts k) (counts (k + 1))

def NonreachCertificate {N : ℕ} (G : Graph N) (a b : Fin N) : Prop :=
  ∃ counts, CountTrace G a counts ∧
    ∃ S, Census G a N (counts N) S ∧ b ∉ S

end Lax733996.Counting

concepts.title: Correctness of one counting step
concepts.description:
Starting from the correct layer size, valid classifications produce exactly
the size of the next layer. Such classifications exist.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax733996.Counting

/-!
---
title: Correctness of one counting step
type: lemma
---
Starting from the correct layer size, valid classifications produce exactly
the size of the next layer. Such classifications exist.
-/

namespace Lax733996.CountingStep

open Lax307052.Reachability Counting

axiom correct {N : ℕ} (G : Graph N) (a : Fin N) (k d : ℕ) :
  CountStep G a k (layer G a k).card d ↔ d = (layer G a (k + 1)).card

end Lax733996.CountingStep

statements.signature:
correct : ∀ {N : Nat} (G : Lax307052.Reachability.Graph N) (a : Fin N) (k d : Nat),
  Iff (Lax733996.Counting.CountStep G a k (Lax733996.Counting.layer G a k).card d)
    (Eq d (Lax733996.Counting.layer G a (instHAdd.hAdd k 1)).card)

concepts.title: Correctness of the count sequence
concepts.description:
The initial layer consists of the source. Inductive counting certifies
exactly the successive layer sizes, including the final size after $N$ steps.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax733996.Counting

/-!
---
title: Correctness of the count sequence
type: lemma
---
The initial layer consists of the source. Inductive counting certifies
exactly the successive layer sizes, including the final size after $N$ steps.
-/

namespace Lax733996.CountingTrace

open Lax307052.Reachability Counting

axiom correct {N : ℕ} (G : Graph N) (a : Fin N) (counts : ℕ → ℕ) :
  CountTrace G a counts ↔ ∀ k ≤ N, counts k = (layer G a k).card

end Lax733996.CountingTrace

statements.signature:
correct : ∀ {N : Nat} (G : Lax307052.Reachability.Graph N) (a : Fin N) (counts : Nat → Nat),
  Iff (Lax733996.Counting.CountTrace G a counts)
    (∀ (k : Nat), instLENat.le k N → Eq (counts k) (Lax733996.Counting.layer G a k).card)

concepts.title: Logarithmic space for inductive counting
concepts.description:
For a machine using logarithmic space, a nondeterministic machine implements
its configuration counting predicate in logarithmic space. Vertices and
bounded paths are generated sequentially. Every branch halts.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax733996.ConfigurationCounting
import Lax434930.SpaceBounds

/-!
---
title: Logarithmic space for inductive counting
type: lemma
---
For a machine using logarithmic space, a nondeterministic machine implements
its configuration counting predicate in logarithmic space. Vertices and
bounded paths are generated sequentially. Every branch halts.
-/

namespace Lax733996.CountMachine

open Lax434930.PolynomialTime Lax434930.SpaceMachines Lax434930.SpaceBounds
open ConfigurationCounting

axiom implement (M : Machine) (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hM : ∀ w, M.UsesSpace w (c * logSpace w.length)) :
  ∃ (d : ℕ) (D : Machine), 0 < d ∧
    (∀ w, D.HaltsOn w ∧ (D.Accepts w ↔ RejectsByCounting M w (c * logSpace w.length))) ∧
    ∀ w, D.UsesSpace w (d * logSpace w.length)

end Lax733996.CountMachine

statements.signature:
implement : ∀ (M : Lax434930.SpaceMachines.Machine) (c : Nat),
  instLTNat.lt 0 c →
    (∀ (w : Lax434930.PolynomialTime.Word),
        M.UsesSpace w (instHMul.hMul c (Lax434930.SpaceBounds.logSpace (List.length w)))) →
      Exists fun d =>
        Exists fun D =>
          And (instLTNat.lt 0 d)
            (And
              (∀ (w : Lax434930.PolynomialTime.Word),
                And (D.HaltsOn w)
                  (Iff (D.Accepts w)
                    (Lax733996.ConfigurationCounting.RejectsByCounting M w
                      (instHMul.hMul c (Lax434930.SpaceBounds.logSpace (List.length w))))))
              (∀ (w : Lax434930.PolynomialTime.Word),
                D.UsesSpace w (instHMul.hMul d (Lax434930.SpaceBounds.logSpace (List.length w)))))

concepts.title: Exact censuses enumerate the whole layer
concepts.description:
A census of reachable vertices with the correct cardinality contains every
vertex of the layer. Distinctness is enforced by the finite-set representation.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax733996.Counting

/-!
---
title: Exact censuses enumerate the whole layer
type: lemma
---
A census of reachable vertices with the correct cardinality contains every
vertex of the layer. Distinctness is enforced by the finite-set representation.
-/

namespace Lax733996.ExactCensus

open Lax307052.Reachability Counting

axiom complete {N : ℕ} (G : Graph N) (a : Fin N) (k : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin N)) :
  Census G a k (layer G a k).card S → S = layer G a k

end Lax733996.ExactCensus

statements.signature:
complete : ∀ {N : Nat} (G : Lax307052.Reachability.Graph N) (a : Fin N) (k : Nat) (S : Finset (Fin N)),
  Lax733996.Counting.Census G a k (Lax733996.Counting.layer G a k).card S → Eq S (Lax733996.Counting.layer G a k)

concepts.description:

concepts.sourceText:

/-!
---
title: The Immerman–Szelepcsényi theorem
type: theorem
---
Nondeterministic logarithmic space is closed under complement:
$\mathrm{NL}=\mathrm{coNL}$.
-/

namespace Lax733996.NLcoNL

open Lax434930.NondeterministicLogarithmicSpace Lax434930.ComplementClasses

axiom nl_eq_conl : NL = coNL

end Lax733996.NLcoNL

concepts.title: Correctness of nonreachability certificates
concepts.description:
A valid sequence of counts and a final census omitting the target exist
exactly when the target is unreachable from the source.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax733996.Counting

/-!
---
title: Correctness of nonreachability certificates
type: lemma
---
A valid sequence of counts and a final census omitting the target exist
exactly when the target is unreachable from the source.
-/

namespace Lax733996.Nonreachability

open Lax307052.Reachability Counting

axiom correct {N : ℕ} (G : Graph N) (a b : Fin N) :
  NonreachCertificate G a b ↔ ¬ Reachable G a b

end Lax733996.Nonreachability

statements.signature:
correct : ∀ {N : Nat} (G : Lax307052.Reachability.Graph N) (a b : Fin N),
  Iff (Lax733996.Counting.NonreachCertificate G a b) (Not (Lax307052.Reachability.Reachable G a b))

concepts.title: Correctness of rejection by counting
concepts.description:
On a space-bounded computation, counting certifies rejection precisely when
there is no accepting computation.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax733996.ConfigurationCounting

/-!
---
title: Correctness of rejection by counting
type: lemma
---
On a space-bounded computation, counting certifies rejection precisely when
there is no accepting computation.
-/

namespace Lax733996.Rejection

open Lax434930.PolynomialTime Lax434930.SpaceMachines ConfigurationCounting

axiom correct (M : Machine) (w : Word) (s : ℕ) (hs : M.UsesSpace w s) :
  RejectsByCounting M w s ↔ ¬ M.Accepts w

end Lax733996.Rejection

  M.UsesSpace w s → Iff (Lax733996.ConfigurationCounting.RejectsByCounting M w s) (Not (M.Accepts w))

concepts.title: The next reachable layer
concepts.description:
A vertex belongs to the next layer precisely when it is the source or has
an incoming edge from the current layer.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax733996.Counting

/-!
---
title: The next reachable layer
type: lemma
---
A vertex belongs to the next layer precisely when it is the source or has
an incoming edge from the current layer.
-/

namespace Lax733996.SuccessorLayer

open Lax307052.Reachability Counting

axiom successor {N : ℕ} (G : Graph N) (a v : Fin N) (k : ℕ) :
  v ∈ layer G a (k + 1) ↔ v = a ∨ ∃ u ∈ layer G a k, G u v = true

end Lax733996.SuccessorLayer

statements.signature:
successor : ∀ {N : Nat} (G : Lax307052.Reachability.Graph N) (a v : Fin N) (k : Nat),
  Iff (SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax733996.Counting.layer G a (instHAdd.hAdd k 1)) v)
    (Or (Eq v a)
      (Exists fun u => And (SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax733996.Counting.layer G a k) u) (Eq (G u v) Bool.true)))

proofs.description: An exact census makes the negative test exhaustive.
The counting machine accepts the complement and preserves a logarithmic space bound.
Apply the nonreachability certificate to each possible accepting configuration.
The vertices classified positively are exactly the next layer.
Induct from the singleton initial layer through the certified counting steps.

Compile the sequential path and census loops to a finite Turing machine.
Every branch halts and every register has logarithmic length.
A finite subset with the same cardinality is the entire layer.
Apply complement closure in both directions and use double complementation.
The final exact census contains every reachable vertex, so omitting the target certifies nonreachability.
Remove the last edge of a nonempty walk; the empty walk ends at the source.
